scenes.title: Pack for *3 days.*
scenes.say: Forty-nine thousand people were told to pack for three days. They never came back.

scenes.title: The Chernobyl plant
scenes.say: Pripyat was a young city built for the workers of the Chernobyl nuclear plant, just three kilometres away. At one twenty-three in the morning, on April twenty-sixth, nineteen eighty-six, Reactor Four exploded.
scenes.display: Pripyat was a young city built for the workers of the Chernobyl nuclear plant, just three kilometres away. At 1:23 in the morning, on April 26th, 1986, Reactor Four exploded.

scenes.say: But through Saturday, life in Pripyat went on almost as normal. It took around thirty-six hours before the city was evacuated, on the afternoon of the twenty-seventh.
scenes.display: But through Saturday, life in Pripyat went on almost as normal. It took around 36 hours before the city was evacuated, on the afternoon of the 27th.

scenes.title: Residents were told:
scenes.say: Residents were told it would only be for three days. Buses took the whole city away in a single afternoon.

scenes.title: Still *off-limits*
scenes.say: They never returned. Today, Pripyat sits inside a thirty-kilometre exclusion zone. Its apartments, its schools, and its famous Ferris wheel have been empty for forty years.

scenes.title: *350,000* people moved
scenes.say: In total, around three hundred and fifty thousand people were eventually moved from their homes because of Chernobyl.
Could you leave everything behind? The full story is on our channel.
